description: Customer service chatbot session — React + FastAPI + PostgreSQL + Salesforce CRM

steps.name: Session Initialization
steps.description: Bootstrap session context: generate session ID, load user preferences, initialize token counter, set up audit trail.
steps.notes: No LLM call. Pure Python/FastAPI initialization. Cost is $0.00.

steps.name: Context Load
steps.description: Retrieve conversation history from PostgreSQL, format prior turns, inject system prompt. Output is structured context block for downstream steps.
steps.notes: Haiku is sufficient for history formatting and summarization. Input includes raw DB rows; output is a clean context block.

steps.name: Intent Classification
steps.description: Classify the user's message into one of 12 intent categories (billing, technical, returns, escalation, general_inquiry, etc.). Output is a structured JSON label with confidence score.
steps.notes: Short-output classification. Haiku handles 12-class classification reliably. Feeds account_lookup and response_generation routing.

steps.name: Account Lookup
steps.description: Query Salesforce CRM for customer account details, open cases, subscription tier, and billing history. Parse the API response into a normalized account summary.
steps.notes: Input is raw Salesforce JSON (~2K tokens). Output is a concise account summary. Haiku handles JSON-to-summary reliably.

steps.name: Issue Analysis
steps.description: Analyze the customer's issue in light of their account history, open cases, and subscription tier. Identify root cause, severity, and recommended resolution path. This step requires genuine reasoning.
steps.notes: Sonnet required — multi-step reasoning over account history and issue context. Output feeds both response_generation and crm_update.

steps.name: Response Generation
steps.description: Draft the customer-facing response. Must be empathetic, accurate, brand-voice compliant, and include any required disclosures. Output is the final message sent to the customer.
steps.notes: Sonnet required — customer-facing quality bar. Input includes full context + issue_analysis output + brand guidelines.

steps.name: Knowledge Base Research Loop
steps.description: Iteratively search the internal knowledge base when issue_analysis cannot resolve the case from account data alone. Each iteration: embed query → vector search → read article → assess sufficiency → continue or stop.
steps.notes: PRIMARY RUNAWAY RISK. Each iteration costs ~$0.0148 at Sonnet pricing. 5 planned iterations = $0.074; 8 max iterations = $0.118. BudgetGovernor must re-evaluate task projection after each iteration and halt if task_cap would be breached.

steps.name: CRM Update
steps.description: Write structured interaction summary, resolution notes, and case status update back to Salesforce. Generate field-mapped JSON payload conforming to Salesforce Case object schema.
steps.notes: Haiku sufficient for structured JSON generation with a well-defined schema. Salesforce API call follows the LLM step.

steps.name: Support Ticket Creation
steps.description: Create a formal support ticket in the case management system when the issue cannot be fully resolved in-session (e.g., requires engineering, billing adjustment > $500, or executive escalation).
steps.notes: Optional — only triggered on escalation path. Roughly 15% of sessions.

steps.name: Email Notification
steps.description: Generate and send a confirmation email to the customer summarizing the interaction, any ticket number, and expected resolution timeline. Uses a Jinja2 template; LLM fills variable content blocks.
steps.notes: Optional — triggered by user preference or ticket_creation. ~60% of sessions. Haiku for template filling.

steps.name: Session Close
steps.description: Flush token counters, write actual spend to ledger, record resolution outcome, archive conversation to cold storage, release session resources.
steps.notes: No LLM call. Infra teardown. Triggers ledger update with actual_cost_usd.
